rows.action: Validate the ce55 QDP field/command target contract, additive publish command, PCBA sidecar exact-writer allowlist, lifecycle locks, composite-duty permissions, UI references, dictionaries, layout and global field-code uniqueness.
rows.assertion: All 20 ce55 QDP fields and the legacy Customer Request release target remain addressable; lifecycle publish reuses the same handler, and the sidecar accepts only the two exact CRM QDP release commands.

rows.action: Exercise prepare, review, release, replay, stale, tamper, external-file failure and supersede branches directly against the existing QDP writer.
rows.assertion: The writer fails closed on invalid bindings and preserves lifecycle, idempotency and compare-and-set invariants.

rows.action: Compare aura plugin validate output at ce55 and the current branch.
rows.assertion: The current CLI rejects three host-supported command properties per command: ce55 has 3 diagnostics and this branch has 12, a net +9 for three additive commands; fresh host import and execution pass.

rows.action: Prepare a QDP from a qualified PCBA sidecar, completed retained file bytes, immutable Requirement Version, File Package and Customer Confirmation records.
rows.assertion: Customer Confirmation binds the exact Requirement Version and canonical SHA-256 file-package hash; tamper and missing-retention attempts fail closed.

rows.action: Drive Draft to Ready for Review to Released and release a later revision that supersedes the prior release.
rows.assertion: Released content is never edited in place; a new release supersedes the previous Released record with a compare-and-set transition.

rows.action: Persist and read version-diff, Pack Set, downstream-impact, assumptions and approved-exception snapshots through prepare/review/release.
rows.assertion: GT-D04 inputs remain bound to the immutable QDP content and are visible as human-readable summaries in Release Center.

rows.action: Inventory the full target QDP lifecycle against implemented orchestration.
rows.assertion: Draft, Ready for Review, Released and Superseded execute; Compiling and Validation Failed are reserved dictionary states without an asynchronous compiler in this slice.

groups.title: Permissions, tenancy, concurrency, replay, audit and external failure

rows.action: Send missing/stale expected versions, identical replay identities and changed-intent replays at prepare/review/release boundaries.
rows.assertion: The target aggregate and QDP transitions enforce optimistic concurrency, stable replay and conflict rejection.

rows.action: Attempt lifecycle commands without permission, across tenant boundaries and through direct model writes, then inspect audit and field metadata.
rows.assertion: No-permission returns 403, cross-tenant access is denied, direct writes cannot bypass exact command writers, release requires an explicitly assigned cross-owner duty role, and 9 audit rows capture the fresh-host probes.

rows.action: Delete or invalidate the referenced file after draft creation, observe release failure, restore a valid retained file and retry with a valid transition identity.
rows.assertion: External file-retention failure is explicit and fail-closed; recovery does not corrupt lifecycle state and can subsequently release.

rows.action: Open the Release Center list and released detail in a freshly assembled browser runtime.
rows.assertion: Lifecycle, GT-D04, hashes, confirmation, diff, Pack Set, impacts and audit are localized and readable without raw JSON or pid leakage.
rows.vision_check: Current-source original-resolution screenshots show localized lifecycle states, separated full-width hashes/diff, customer confirmation, PCBA-MFG@browser and 1 downstream object(s), 0 blocked; no raw field code or JSON is visible.

rows.action: Trigger a stale source release and open Release Center as a role without access.
rows.assertion: Stale feedback tells the user to prepare a new revision; the denied role sees Page Unavailable/Access denied and no QDP menu, data or actions.
rows.vision_check: Original screenshots visibly contain the stale error and no-permission boundary.
